_comment: Alert policies applied via 'gcloud alpha monitoring policies create --policy-from-file=<file>'. Replace ${CHANNEL_ID} with the channel name returned by setup.sh (e.g. projects/PROJECT_ID/notificationChannels/123).

documentation.content: Triggers when the feedback-api Cloud Function returns 5xx errors at a non-trivial rate. Investigate logs at https://console.cloud.google.com/logs.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "feedback-api" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"

documentation.content: Triggers when the urgent-feedback notification function fails. Likely causes: Gmail auth failure, malformed Pub/Sub envelope, or admin-email secret missing.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "notification-handler" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"

documentation.content: Triggers when the weekly report function fails. The job runs on Cloud Scheduler 'weekly-report-job' (Mon 11:00 UTC); a failed run usually means a Firestore or SMTP problem.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "weekly-report" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"
